name: Secrets Impression Isla Mujeres
positioning: All-inclusive, all-suite resort for adults, officially named Impression Isla Mujeres by Secrets, perched atop a coastal cliff on the southern coastline of Isla Mujeres with access to a private beach
best_for: Couples looking for a romantic getaway on an island
Travelers who want an all-inclusive stay with a dedicated butler

facts.text: The resort is built into the natural landscape of the southern coastline of Isla Mujeres.
Isla Mujeres is an island that spans only 5 miles, with coral reefs, a rocky coastline and ancient Mayan ruins.
The private beach has a naturally sheltered setting that is seldom affected by sargassum.
Guests have a dedicated butler during their stay.
Suites have in-suite wine refrigerators, private balconies, dual rain showers and premium bath amenities.
Room categories range from Junior Suites to Presidential Suites with ocean views.
The all-inclusive stay includes unlimited premium spirits, a la carte dining, and curated activities and entertainment.
There are seven dining venues, including two signature restaurants, Spezia and UNIK The Kitchen.
The architecture and art by local artists represent the local community.
The resort uses solar panels for water heating, has no single-use plastics on property and runs an on-site glass bottling plant.
Guests can explore Isla Mujeres by electric bike or complimentary cruiser.

highlights.text: The resort is perched atop a coastal cliff with access to a private beach.
A four-story waterslide drops guests into the ocean.
Guests can watch the sunset from overwater torch-lit cabanas.
The resort has rooftop infinity pools.
PURE SPA by Natura Bisse offers hydrotherapy, Hammam cleansing therapy and a Floatarium.

considerations.text: The resort is designed for adults, for relaxation or a romantic getaway.
Flip-flops are not allowed in certain dining venues.
Golf is offered through access at Puerto Cancun Golf Club.
